question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` intentionally reject equivalent plus-prefixed and zero-padded decimal spellings that the current CLI accepts?
rationale: The listed inputs do not alter the requested cadence, so rejecting them is a breaking CLI syntax policy choice rather than a demonstrated correctness repair.

options.title: Preserve compatibility
options.body: Keep accepting equivalent decimal spellings and close or narrow this PR unless a genuinely misinterpreted interval input is demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt canonical-only syntax
options.body: Approve the breaking syntax restriction, document it as an intentional CLI contract change, and require real upgrade and launcher proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep accepting equivalent decimal spellings and close or narrow this PR unless a genuinely misinterpreted interval input is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Policy watch and attestation behavior whose CLI contract is being changed.
